_what: [SUPERSEDED by t-opt-synth-matrix.json] Single-client performance ablation (A lights-off / A2 beamIdle early-out / B 64-step exact / C 32-step+TM / D occl table on / E rollback). Light gate = ssbo count (A must be 0, others >=2). Coverage gap: this rig can only reach 2 active lights on a single client, so optimization-3 mode-1 (row_b1, light index >=4) is NOT covered by this ticket set.
_prereq: SINGLE CLIENT is enough for every arm in this spec (light gate: A=0, others>=2 = handheld + gun light on the measured client). No observer instances required. Multi-client (>='3' clients) would be needed ONLY to reach the 6-light case that exercises row_b1 -- see dev3/eight-light-coverage-gap.md.
_primary_metric: relay !bench x3 (3s window) median avgFPS -- the ticket bench op is SECONDARY only (instant mc.getFps())
_roi: per shot: Y-mean over the beam/pool ROI; floor = the 3 same-config shots of that arm; signal must exceed 3x floor; never use raw changed%; exclude the TACZ thin white ballistic line and the HUD from the ROI mask

_judgment.light_gate_fails: setup problem, NOT a product result: fix the client count/lamps and rerun (ssbo count is GPU-readback evidence)
_judgment.A_to_B: total light cost (denominator); A must show count=0
_judgment.A2_vs_B: optimization-1 upper bound (early-out); there is no knob that disables beamIdle, so A2 (density 0 on all lights) is the closest control
_judgment.C_to_D: optimization-3 as far as this rig can reach: with 2 lights the occl-table path runs block0 / 4-light table only. The mode-1 path (row_b1, light index >=4) is UNREACHABLE on a single client and is therefore NOT covered.
_judgment.D_vs_E: occl off rollback must land next to C; a gap means the table path diverges from exact DDA
_judgment.compare_to_docs23: only same-round deltas and directions may be compared with docs/23 section 2 (4K single/double light cone20); never absolute values
_judgment.row_b1_unreachable: PROVEN unreachable here: scan of all run/logs (661 files incl. receipts) shows ssbo count only ever 0/1/2; self lights are <=2 (ClientSpotlightUploader.java:93-128) and remote lights only come from OTHER players in mc.level.players() (L130/L299-316); row_b1 needs light index >=4 (composite1.fsh:147-153). No light-spawning backdoor exists in src.

scoped: window 1280x800 (options.txt fullscreen:false + overrideWidth 1280/overrideHeight 800) / dev save "test" / scene wall / pose wall_front(2000.0,121.5,8.0,yaw180,pitch5) / midnight + doDaylightCycle false + weather clear + doMobSpawning false / wait 20 / >=5 active lights (multi-client) / cone default / TM on at ticket tail / single main instance measured, observers only supply lights
recipe: See docs/evidence/2026-09-15-oldtrack-verify/dev3/eight-light-recipe.md -- the rig has NEVER run >2 lights (proved: max ssbo count=2 over every log 08-26..09-16); >=5 lights requires >=3 clients (main + 2..3 observer instances) within remoteLightMaxDist=48, each holding flashlight on + gun light (remote lights travel through server-synced entity data, PlayerLightAccess.java:24-45); the main client must have -RelayExtra pointing at every observer run/taclight-cmds.txt.

arms.desc: beam 0.25 / occl off / tm off / selflight on
arms.expect: 64 步精确（旧行为基准）：A→B 的差=灯总开销

arms.desc: beam 0.25 / occl off / tm on / selflight on
arms.expect: 优化2（32 步＋时间复用）：B→C 的差=优化2 收益

arms.desc: beam 0.25 / occl on / tm on / selflight on
arms.expect: 优化3（8 灯遮挡查表，灯4..7 走 row_b1）：C→D 的差=优化3 收益；本轮首次真正压到该分支

arms.desc: beam 0.25 / occl off / tm on / selflight on
arms.expect: 回退验证：应与 C 同量级（occl off 一键回精确 DDA）
